Components

Every Mosaic component, as the app really draws it. Generated from build/design-components.mjs, which is also what produces the stylesheet, the design system's copy, and the prompts Claude Design composes with. If this page is right, all four are.

Core

Button

.m-btn

The standard action. Primary for the one thing a screen is for, secondary for the alternative, ghost for everything that would otherwise be a link.

variant primary · secondary · ghost · quiet · danger
size sm · md · lg

IconButton

.m-icon-btn

A square button holding one Material Symbol. Toolbar actions, close buttons, the floating action button. Always carries an aria-label — an icon alone is not a name.

variant ghost · outline · primary · fab
size sm · md · lg

Forms

Input

.m-input

A single-line text field, its label, and its error. There were four spellings of this across the app before it was named.

state default · invalid · disabled

Select

.m-select

A native dropdown matched to Input, with an inline chevron drawn as a Material Symbol rather than a bundled SVG.

state default · disabled

Checkbox

.m-check

A checkbox and its label, as one target. The whole row is clickable, because a 16px box is a miss on a phone.

state default · checked · disabled

SearchBar

.m-search

An Input with a leading search glyph and a clear button that only appears once there is something to clear.

search

Display

SectionLabel

.m-label

The tracked-caps overline above a group of things. The most-repeated pattern in the app by a distance — about 146 hand-written copies in five different spellings before it was named, one of which reached for text-gray-500.

size sm · md

SerifHead

.m-serif-head

An EB Garamond heading for the things a person reads rather than operates — a hymn name, a role, a one-line summary.

size md · lg

A flat container with a warm hairline. The default surface for grouping anything.

variant default · interactive · raised

.m-nav-card

The dashboard tile: a medallion, a title, one line of description. Four identical copies of this lived in shepherding-dashboard.html alone.

The round icon plate on a NavCard. Fills with --primary-fixed when its card is hovered.

Badge

.m-badge

A small rectangular tag: a theological theme, a ministry area, a state. Rectangular, not a pill — pills read too casual against the liturgy.

tone neutral · primary · secondary · tertiary · success · warning · error

Avatar

.m-avatar

A Person's Directory Photo, or their initials when there is none. Framing comes from PersonPhotoCore so the reframing preview and every card agree.

A quoted passage set in EB Garamond with a gold hairline down its edge, and the reference beneath in tracked caps.

The page's waiting state. Thirteen pages drew this by hand with the same three classes and a 48px Material Symbol.

Toast

.m-toast

A short confirmation at the foot of the screen. Error is the only loud tone; everything else is the calm one.

EmptyState

.m-empty

What a list says when it has nothing in it. An icon and one calm line inside a dashed container — never italic grey text, which reads as an apology for a state that is usually normal.
